symptom: A mapping names a schema source that does not exist and mxcli writes it through — mxbuild reports it as **CE1613** "… no longer exists" at build time, while `mxcli check` and even `check --references` pass; and the same typo silently switches off EVERY member check in that mapping
cause: The schema index is empty whenever the structure cannot be loaded FOR ANY REASON, and `resolvable()` reads an empty index as "there is nothing to validate against" (its correct meaning for a schema-less mapping). So `with json structure M.NoSuchThing { create M.Loc { LocId = nonsense } }` had two errors and reported neither. Separately `null values` was written as free text, so `null values Banana` reached the stored NullValueOption verbatim — the enum is {LeaveOutElement, SendAsNil}
insight: **Refuse at the SOURCE, do not make `resolvable()` stricter**: a NAMED but unresolvable source is an error, while NO source at all — XML schema, message definition, schema-less test mappings — must keep working, and conflating the two breaks every one of them. **An empty project and a backend that cannot LIST look identical from here**, so the refusal only fires when the listing succeeds; a listing error takes the name at face value. That distinction has teeth: two pre-existing mock tests named a structure their mock did not provide and started failing, and the right fix was to give the mock the structure rather than weaken the check — a mapping whose named source does not exist is an inconsistent model to assert against. Name what would have worked, the shape #882 established for members. **Still written through**: `with xml schema M.NoSuchThing`. A gen type exists (`modelsdk/gen/xmlschemas`) so it is verifiable, but it needs a new `ListXmlSchemas` across the interface, both engines and the mock; the silent-disabling half does not apply there, since an XML mapping never had member validation at all. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-259-resolve-schema-sources.mdl`, tests `mdl/executor/mapping_source_resolution_test.go`. Issue ako/mxcli#259
